title: Gold Bar XL Berry Blast Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Berry Blast brings together a mix of dark and red Berries in a rich, full-flavoured vape that's sweet, slightly tart and packed with fruit character. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid to deliver long-lasting MTL satisfaction and smooth vapour with every puff. These refills are made for the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit a user-friendly device powered by a 1200mAh rechargeable battery. The pod contains a built-in mesh coil to optimise flavour delivery and maintain steady vapour output. When the pod and refill are empty, simply swap for a new flavour from the growing Gold Bar XL collection.
